name: gps-plus-slam-wayfinding-hud-demo
description: Demo consuming gps-plus-slam-app-framework: the wayfinding HUD (edge arrows, on-screen rings, distance labels with hysteresis) guiding to targets. Runs in AR on-device with tap-to-place waypoints, and on the desktop as a WASD/mouse walk simulator driving the same HUD.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:framework && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build
scripts.test:core: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run check:all && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e:headed: pnpm run build:framework && playwright test --config playwright-tests/playwright.config.js --headed
scripts.test:e2e:ui: pnpm run build:framework && playwright test --config playwright-tests/playwright.config.js --ui
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check:dup && pnpm run check:cycles && pnpm run check:boundaries
